topIssues.title: New landing page
topIssues.author: sbvegan
topIssues.body:

## Description 
<!-- Write a clear and concise description of the docs request. For example, is the request related to an existing page or are you suggesting a brand-new docs page? -->
We're going to need a new landing page that directs developer to their correct area of interest. Currently it just points you to how to launch a chain. Instead it should guide users to different sections of the documentation for chain operators, node operators, protocol information, superchain information, governance stuff, and protocol notices.

topIssues.title: Clarify the pebble db path vs hash state scheme
topIssues.author: sbvegan
topIssues.body:

## Description 
<!-- Write a clear and concise description of the docs request. For example, is the request related to an existing page or are you suggesting a brand-new docs page? -->
- Internally we have confirmed pebble/path works with full nodes, but we haven't really tested archive pebble/path nodes. All of our full nodes are configured that way.
- However we don't run any archive pebble/path nodes currently because they don't support all the functionality we need for archive rpc (specifically eth_getProof for historical blocks)
